title: Stitch Ops QuickSheet (ad-hoc coverage & effort)
content:
Purpose: quick, single-page tracker for small cross-team handoffs and one-off coverage requests. Use this to triage owner + ETA + minimal blockers; not a replacement for a full ticket, but will seed tickets where needed.

Context/when to use: short-lived surge coverage (<=2 weeks), quick integration touches, patch rollouts and weekend oncall handbacks. Meant to be fast to edit in meetings.

Summary metrics (snapshot 2026-04-07):
- total lines: 8
- open/active: 6
- blocked: 3
- estimated remaining effort: 28h
- available contributor capacity (this week): 20h -> gap: -8h (we need one additional 8h owner or push scope)

Quick grid (columns: item | primary | backup | ETA | effort (hrs) | priority | status | notes)
1) Auth routing fallback | Ravi Patel | Jordan Miles | 2026-04-09 | 8 | P0 | in_progress | relies on infra hotfix (PR 679), kube cordon scheduled 04-08 02:00 UTC
2) Canary capacity for eu-west | Ana López | Priya Nair | 2026-04-10 | 6 | P1 | blocked | missing quota approval from cloud-ops (ticket PROJ-1124)
3) Console token billing audit | Maya Chen | (none) | 2026-04-12 | 4 | P2 | needs_info | pulling CSV from billing export, need invoices from Feb-Mar
4) Observability trace gap check | Jordan Miles | Ravi Patel | 2026-04-11 | 3 | P1 | in_review | found 12% sampling drop, quick patch in agent config pending
5) Private deploy smoke plan (minimal) | Priya Nair | Ana López | 2026-04-13 | 4 | P1 | assigned | runbook draft available in linked confluence
6) Customer: SE pilot readiness (small) | Ana López | Maya Chen | 2026-04-14 | 6 | P2 | blocked | waiting on SE test keys; SE pinged 04-06
7) Rollback checklist validation | Jordan Miles | (none) | 2026-04-09 | 2 | P0 | done | validated in staging, documented in PR comments
8) Minor docs update (billing FAQ) | Maya Chen | Priya Nair | 2026-04-15 | 2 | P3 | assigned | quick copy change, low risk

Notes on interpretation: effort numbers are best-effort guesstimates for sprint planning — assume 25% variance. 'Blocked' captures anything needing external approval (cloud quota, customer keys, legal sign-off).

Immediate asks (what I need from teams right now):
- Cloud-ops: quota approval for eu-west canary by EOD 2026-04-08 (owner: Tom W.). If not approved, we will postpone canary by 48 hours.
- SE: deliver test keys or accept emulated mode for pilot by 2026-04-09.
- SRE: verify infra hotfix schedule and confirm no overlap with other maintenance windows (owner: Jordan / Ravi).

Decision log (short):
- 2026-04-01: decided to run quick canary in eu-west instead of us-west to reduce regional blast radius (owners: Ana + Ravi).
- 2026-04-05: split Auth routing work into hotfix (8h) + follow-up hardening (separate ticket).

Next steps (owners & micro-actions):
- Maya: assemble billing CSV and share redacted slice in #ops-billing (due 2026-04-07)
- Ravi: finalize PR 679 sign-off and coordinate 04-08 kube cordon (due 2026-04-08)
- Ana: chase quota approval with cloud-ops and post status in this doc (due 2026-04-07)
- Priya: draft private-deploy smoke checklist and attach to confluence doc (due 2026-04-10)

Slack/communication: prefer updates in #stitch-ops (thread: "quicksheet-apr-2026"). If blocked by external teams, tag the team leads and @oncall.

Where to escalate: product-ops leads (maya.chen@redwood.com) for prioritization; infra leads (ravi.patel@redwood.com) for scheduling conflicts.

Open questions / TODOs (short):
- Should billing audit be expanded to include March usage anomalies? (Maya to propose scope 04-07)
- Do we need a dedicated 4hr overlap window for canary validation across PST/UTC? (Ana to coordinate)

If you add a row: include a single-line ticket placeholder (Jira/PR link) and label the row with 'short' | 'medium' | 'long' to indicate if it belongs here. Keep edits terse — this doc is intentionally lightweight.

History/versions (light):
- v0.1 2026-04-01 initial scratch
- v0.2 2026-04-05 split auth hotfix + follow-up
- v0.3 2026-04-07 metric snapshot + blockers updated

Footer: tracker owned by Maya Chen (product-ops). If you want this formalized into a ticket, add a linked_artifacts entry and change status to in_review.
